divergences_classified_against.source: the tree this corpus is committed with

input: one SNV per locus at 32 chromosome 21 loci chosen from the cache's transcript set so that each 5 kb window holds transcripts of several biotypes, canonical and non-canonical, on both strands, with loci whose window holds no protein-coding transcript and loci above 40 Mb; three records carry two alternate alleles; the reference base is the GRCh38 primary assembly's
generator: tools/vep-golden-corpus select --release 116 --assembly GRCh38 --dataset tf=<reference>=<input> --k 100 --seed 1 --covers transcript_filter --matrix tests/parity/matrix.tsv --out tests/golden/116/GRCh38-transcript-filter; scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --gzip --drop sorted_exons --drop protein_features --drop protein_function_predictions --perl-info <cache>/info.txt --cache-version 116; tools/vep-golden-corpus flag-set (one per flag set) and classify (the manifest's run and each flag set)

filter-biotype.vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 116 --species homo_sapiens --assembly GRCh38 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite --transcript_filter 'biotype is protein_coding' [--tab|--vcf|--json]

filter-not-match.vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 116 --species homo_sapiens --assembly GRCh38 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite --transcript_filter 'not biotype match pseudogene' [--tab|--vcf|--json]

filter-in-file.vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 116 --species homo_sapiens --assembly GRCh38 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite --transcript_filter 'stable_id in transcript_ids.txt' [--tab|--vcf|--json]

flags: (biotype is protein_coding and is_canonical) or start > 40000000
filter-parens.vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 116 --species homo_sapiens --assembly GRCh38 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite --transcript_filter '(biotype is protein_coding and is_canonical) or start > 40000000' [--tab|--vcf|--json]

filter-repeated.vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 116 --species homo_sapiens --assembly GRCh38 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite --transcript_filter 'biotype is protein_coding' --transcript_filter 'not is_canonical' [--tab|--vcf|--json]
